ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels and 15% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous bands along the trailing edges of both lobes; dispersed circular white focal spots distributed throughout the dark medial and anterior fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate 105-degree angle; depth is approximately 18% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge boundary; right lobe exhibits larger pixel-amplitude variance (peaks and valleys) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory of the trailing edge curve sweeping from the medial notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white pixel aggregates concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe and scattered across the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple light-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the dark medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of circular barnacle attachment scars and multiple sets of linear rake mark abrasions across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white pigmentation concentration following the posterior margin of the right fluke lobe.
